failures.root_cause: In sw-lib-test-gate-env-test, the assertion 'outside the gate the saved header is untouched' fails: test-gate-env.sh modifies or does not preserve the saved header when run outside a test gate. The environment may leak gate state (for example a SHIPWRIGHT_TEST_GATE variable) into the test, since CI itself runs inside a test gate.
failures.fix: Unset the gate env vars (e.g. SHIPWRIGHT_TEST_GATE) in the failing test's 'outside the gate' case, or fix lib/test-gate-env.sh so it leaves the saved header untouched when no gate is active. Then rerun with `bash scripts/sw-test-all.sh --pattern sw-lib-test-gate-env`.

failures.pattern: BLOCKING: 'npm run test:ts' (exit 127) failed, and no trustworthy base-commit baseline could be established (the base command could not run (exit 127)). Treated as a regression. Fix it.
failures.root_cause: The 'npm run test:ts' command exited 127 (command not found) because the test:ts script or its runner (bun/vitest) isn't installed or on PATH in the environment; the base commit also couldn't run it, so no baseline existed and the gate treated it as a regression. The bash suite (npm test) itself passed 173/173.
failures.fix: Ensure bun/vitest is installed and on PATH in the test stage (e.g. run 'bun install' or set up Bun before 'npm run test:ts'), and confirm a 'test:ts' script exists in package.json.
